meta.note: Classic y is the capsule bottom minus its resting gap over flat ground (the controller offset). Classic parts are 0.015 lower than their plate multiple and 0.035 narrower (collider inset); Hackable parts are exact multiples. Classic sampled at 60 Hz (traces keep every other frame), Hackable at 30 Hz. Air times and landing spots are compared at 30 Hz on both (the classic 60 Hz spells are kept as airborne60Hz). Times are seconds since the keys started (tick 10). Trace rows: [t, x, y, z, grounded].
